Elon Musk: "Tesla recruiting does not have anything that says 'requires university' because that's absurd."

Instead, Musk says Tesla looks for evidence of exceptional ability.

• A college degree is not considered proof of exceptional ability.
• Candidates should demonstrate that they've actually done something exceptional.
• Musk points to successful people who dropped out of college as examples that a degree isn't required for exceptional achievement.
• What matters is ability, results, and evidence of doing something extraordinary.

At Tesla, the focus is on what you can do, not simply where you studied.

Breaking news in Europe:
@Tesla has selected another person in Europe to become a Tesla Model S signature owner.
This one is number 75 and the owner is from Romania.🇷🇴 
We knew that Tesla took great care in selecting the happy few (only 20 in Europe) and I must say this owner has an amazing story to tell before he got selected.
Read his amazing story below.

The owner:
My journey with Tesla began six years ago with a Tesla Model 3 Performance. At the time, many people believed that an electric car had no place in motorsport. For me, however, it was the beginning of a dream and a mission: to prove that the future could win.

From that very first Model 3 Performance came the first Tesla built for hill climb racing in Europe. Later, I built the world’s first FIA-homologated Tesla Model S Plaid race car. Together with Tesla, we achieved the best result ever by an electric car in European hill climb competition and won the overall classification of a championship round twice. I chose to believe in Tesla’s vision and become part of this community, and today I am proud to own several Tesla models, including the Model S Plaid, Cybertruck, the new Model 3 Performance, and now the Model S Signature.

Behind all these achievements stands an extraordinary team. Tesla Bucharest has been by my side since the very beginning. They believed in my projects and gave me the confidence I needed to keep moving forward. Over the years, they became more than a partner—they became family. Thank you for believing in me and for standing by my side every step of the way.

Being selected to receive the Tesla Model S Signature, one of only 250 produced worldwide and the only one in Romania, is an incredible honor. To me, this car represents far more than exclusivity. It is proof that passion, hard work, perseverance, and loyalty are rewarded.

This is not the end. It is the beginning of a new chapter.
Congratulations again @DominicMarcu with your achievements in racing and with this amazing beauty!
@teslaeurope @elonmusk @EvaFox
